candidate_pool.decode: native checkpoint tokenizer, greedy deterministic, existing frozen configuration

development_pseudo_validation.selection: deterministic SHA-256 order salt ARC2_NATIVE_RANKER_DEV_PSEUDOVALIDATION_V1; excludes frozen30

held_out_validation.selection: deterministic SHA-256 order salt ARC2_NATIVE_RANKER_HELDOUT_V1; selected before any held-out inference; no task-specific filtering

selection_protocol: Select one fixed ranker only from leave-one-train-pair-out pseudo-validation. Do not read development test or held-out outputs during ranker selection.
held_out_protocol: Generate candidate artifact from held-out train pairs plus test inputs, freeze it, then locally open held-out solutions exactly once for scoring.
